parsed.notes:
Dein Skillset is a requirements section; no optional qualification section appears.
Opening role duties, Deine Mission, benefits, company descriptions and search keywords are not independent candidate-skill asks.
AI/ML-Architektur is provisionally mapped to software architecture as well as AI/ML; the architecture mapping is flagged for review.
Open-Source-Modelle denotes open-source LLMs in the explicit LLM and named-model context.
Alternative groups number the representable taxonomy groups. Haystack also belongs to the framework alternatives, and Ollama to the technology alternatives, but both lack taxonomy IDs. The entirely unmapped model alternatives are Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek and Qwen.
Distributed Inference/Training is read literally as distributed inference or distributed training; only training has a taxonomy entry, so no singleton alternative group is emitted.
Tracing and Monitoring collapse into observability. Security and Privacy support cybersecurity and data privacy/security respectively.
Private AI, Sovereign AI and deployment-environment experience are retained as unmapped technical asks rather than silently equated with more general practices.
